stem.en: A voter has seen only the boards outside a polling station: names, symbols and photographs. What does she still not know?

text.en: Who is standing in her constituency
Which symbol goes with which candidate
What each candidate plans to do
Which face goes with which name

explanation.en: The boards already show who is standing, each symbol and each face. They cannot show a candidate's policies, vision or positions on issues. Voters learn those mainly through the political parties.

hints.en: Look at what is printed on a board. Which of the four is not there?
